editorial:
Imagine being a normal girl like Rise, just living your everyday life, and then suddenly stumbling into a world where nothing makes sense. That is exactly how your journey starts here. You get to follow Rise as she meets the original Alice, and the chemistry between these two is just great. The movie feels like a bright, colorful dream that never wants to end. It takes the old story we all know and gives it a fresh, modern spin that makes the whole world feel new and exciting again.

What really makes this one a winner is how the animation looks. The colors pop so much that you will want to see it in the best quality possible. The pacing is quick, though some of the side characters are a bit too weird at first. Still, it is a perfect pick for families or anyone who needs a break from reality.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that Rise was actually a lost memory of Alice from a long time ago. They team up to stop the Queen of Hearts from erasing the colors of Wonderland. After a big battle, Rise uses her modern knowledge to trick the Queen and save everyone. She eventually says goodbye to Alice and wakes up in the real world, but she keeps a small magic key to show it was not just a dream.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical worlds and cute characters
